title: Vibrant Slow-Cooked Tunisian Egg White Tagine
description: A rich, pillowy, high-protein-friendly Tunisian dish featuring egg whites, slow-cooked to perfection in a Binchotan-grill vessel, perfect for a date-night dinner.
instructions: Whisk egg whites until stiff peaks form in a large mixing bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together sliced almonds, chopped pistachios, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, and a pinch of salt.
Add the date mixture to the egg whites and whip until well combined.
Spoon the egg white mixture onto the preheated Binchotan-grill in a circular motion to form a bed of egg whites.
Drizzle the olive oil over the egg whites, followed by the lemon juice and the spice mixture.
Sprinkle the crumbled labneh cheese over the egg whites.
Place the Binchotan-grill under a preheated broiler for 5-7 minutes or until the egg whites are cooked through.
Remove the Binchotan-grill from the oven and sprinkle the black pepper over the egg whites.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sliced almonds and a sprinkle of cinnamon, if desired.
